title: Neutral preview core
note: Wave 1 verifies provider-neutral models, a stream state model, a freshness classifier and a deterministic simulator. Nothing here touches hardware, RTSP, a decoder or any Seestar code. Lifecycle and image freshness are local DB-03 semantics (docs/DB-03_PREVIEW_SEMANTICS.md), not contract requirements.

not_claimed.REQ-058: Concerns Telemetry samples only (decision D3). Image freshness is a separate local definition and is not claimed as REQ-058 coverage.
not_claimed.hardware: No hardware evidence of any kind is claimed by Wave 1.

local_semantics.text: Image metadata and pixels are separate objects; evidence carries no pixels.
host_observed_at is host receipt time; exposure time is UNKNOWN unless the source reports one, and that claim is unverified.
Stream states and transitions are an explicit table; lost and closed are never reactivated.
Freshness is a pure classifier; an age equal to max_age is FRESH.
Repeated content alone is never STALE; corroboration by a frozen source time is required.
Image dimensions and sizes are validated; the pixel buffer is bounded by count and bytes.
The source protocol has open, read and close only; no command surface.
Source faults make the stream LOST without raising; the source is released exactly once; close is idempotent.
Pixels are never written to disk by the neutral core.

REQ-016.text: Preview half: runtime image evidence model with metadata/pixel separation. Operational preview belongs to later waves.

REQ-018.text: Preview data does not automatically become Capture, Frame, Dataset, ProcessingRun, Observation or Session state: evidence is metadata only, pixels stay in memory, outputs carry no domain identity, and a full simulated exercise leaves a canonical database and its directory untouched. Verified for the neutral core only; later waves must re-verify.

REQ-022.text: Passive preview reads submit no Commands: the source protocol and stream expose no command surface.

REQ-030.text: Simulated preview sources and the evidence they produce are marked simulated.

REQ-031.text: Simulator scenarios (fresh, repeat, stall, loss, reopen) are deterministic.

REQ-063.text: Deterministic simulator scenarios: fresh, repeat, stall, loss, reopen; simulated marking.

REQ-059.text: Source protocol exposes no command; a stream never starts, stops or configures a device.

REQ-032.text: No domain Capture or Frame records created.

REQ-033.text: Preview evidence is not a canonical record.

REQ-052.text: Neutral core imports no vendor, domain or storage code.

REQ-064.text: A preview stream, evidence object or pixel buffer does not by itself prove that a Session, Observation, Capture or Frame exists: outputs expose no such identity or claim and are declared runtime evidence only.

REQ-067.text: No acquisition or dataset ownership in the preview core.

correction_note: Wave 2 review corrected five entries whose descriptions did not match the contract text: REQ-018 (preview data must not automatically become Capture, Frame, Dataset, ProcessingRun, Observation or Session state), REQ-022 (passive reads submit no Commands), REQ-030 (simulated outcomes are identified as simulated), REQ-031 (simulator behavior is deterministic) and REQ-064 (a Preview by itself proves no Session, Observation, Capture or Frame exists). Stall and loss semantics are covered by PRV-SEM-003/008, and image freshness by PRV-SEM-004/005, not by those REQs.
